title: [CLM-6] "The provider cannot link your traffic to a particular Space" is absolute
description: Review finding CLM-6: "The provider cannot link your traffic to a particular Space" is absolute (lens CLM). Location: PRFAQ.md:35, 17; PROPOSAL.md:42-43; vs ARCHITECTURE.md:307-313. Fix: As proposed. ARCHITECTURE §9: "A CO with one Space gets none", plus registration-timing correlation and address clustering. PROPOSAL l.42 ("or which channel or Space a routing token belongs to") and PRFAQ l.17 need the same qualifier as l.35. PRFAQ l.31 ("which of a customer's Spaces") needs it too. Full text: notes/review/CLM-verified.md and notes/review/CLM.md.
